newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-ROTOR MAKE RUNNING IN TIGHT RUSSIAN LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROTOR MAKE RUNNING IN TIGHT RUSSIAN LEAGUE.

text.p: Rotor Volgograd beat Lokomotiv Moscow 1-0 in the capital on Saturday to share top spot in a tight Russian premier league with Rostselmash Rostov, who were held 0-0 at home to Zhemchuzhina Sochi.

That the Sochi side, who escaped relegation by one place last season, are just two points off the lead after eight matches shows how unpredictable the start of the season has been, with a number of unfancied teams doing well.

Rotor, who finished third last year after blowing a slim lead in the final fortnight, will be determined to keep up the pressure on injury-hit champions Spartak Moscow, who could only manage a 0-0 draw in St Petersburg against Zenit on Saturday.
Spartak are fourth and level on points with Zhemchuzhina.
A 57th-minute strike from Oleg Terekhin was enough to give Dynamo Moscow an away win over next-to-bottom Fakel Voronezh, leaving them third, a point behind Rotor and Rostov.
Alania Vladikavkaz, the 1996 runners-up who have had a miserable start to the year, had a better result, beating Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod 3-1 away to move up to 10th from 13th.
